newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita leaves 6-mth parent forecast unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita leaves 6-mth parent forecast unchanged.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said it has not changed its forecast for its parent current profit and sales for the six months to September 30, 1996, despite a strong recovery in group earnings in the first quarter of the 1996/97 business year.
Matsushita had projected its half-year parent current profit at 46 billion yen on expected sales of 2.2 trillion yen.
In 1995/96, Matsushita posted an actual interim parent current profit of 41.22 billion yen on half-year sales of 2.16 trillion yen.

"Our first quarter group earnings were very good but there are uncertainties over the overall Japanese economy and the yen rate so we will not revise our parent earnings forecast for now," a Matsushita official said.

Matsushita earlier on Tuesday announced that it had posted a group net profit of 18.5 billion yen in the three months to June 30, 1996, against a loss of 151.3 billion yen in the same period a year ago.
